test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: One pipe can fill a tank in 6 minutes while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 12 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-fourth of the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Time to fill = 6 min

Time to empty = 12 min

Work required = 1/4 of tank

**Formula Used:**

Work = LCM of given times

Rate = Work ÷ Time

Time = Work ÷ Net rate

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 6 and 12 = 12

⇒ Rate of filling pipe = 12 ÷ 6 = 2

⇒ Rate of emptying pipe = 12 ÷ 12 = 1

⇒ Net rate = 2 − 1 = 1

⇒ Time to fill full tank = 12 ÷ 1 = 12

⇒ Time to fill 1/4 tank = 12 ÷ 4 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3 minutes.**
